create_tensorboard_writer: create a TensorboardWriter instance with a log directory to write tensorboard summaries
create_wandb_writer: create a WeightsAndBiasesWriter instance with config to log metrics to wandb
get_writer_from_config: get a logging writer by calling get_writer with a habitat baselines config object
add_video_from_np_images: add a video to tensorboard from a list of numpy image frames with a name and step index
add_scalar_to_wandb: add a single scalar metric to wandb using the WeightsAndBiasesWriter add_scalar method
